rules.z_words: the lab's 95% interval, mean +- 2 SE (E192.md section 6: 'a contrast whose 95% interval (mean +- 2 SE) contains zero')
rules.share_words: a family PASSES when at least K = ceil(0.85 N) of its N registered prices hold; it FAILS when at least F = N - K + 1 miss; NO DATA when none is decided; otherwise NOT DECIDED
rules.decided_words: a price is decided when card 1 has a value with n >= 4 measured passes and an SE no larger than 3 x aifoundry3's SE for the same price; otherwise NOT DECIDED (its reason recorded); a session cut short before its fourth measured pass decides no price (NO DATA)
rules.T1_words: |m1 - m3| <= 2 sqrt(se1^2 + se3^2): card 1's value within the two values' combined 95% interval
rules.T2_words: |m1 - s* m3| <= 2 sqrt(se1^2 + (s* se3)^2), s* = the family's one card-to-card scale: the scale in the allowance [s_lo, s_hi] (which holds 1) under which the most of the family's decided prices hold, found exactly (ties go to the value nearest the clipped s_hat, then nearest 1), so T2 never holds fewer prices than T1. THE SCALE: the weighted least-squares s_hat = sum(w m1 m3) / sum(w m3^2), w = 1 / (se1^2 + se3^2), over the family's decided prices, its SE 1 / sqrt(sum(w m3^2)), times sqrt(chi2 / (D - 1)) when that is above 1; the scale holds when s_hat +- 2 SE meets the allowance (E199.md section 6.4)
